neighbours.label: the word piece just before a word-final 's' syllable (-se / -so / -sa / -с) across scripts: UN[IVER]SE, [immer]se, imp[ul]so, п[уль]с
fire: The documentary was called A SHORT HISTORY OF THE UNIVERSE and ran for two hours.
On holiday she likes to immerse herself in a long novel.
La nueva ley impulsa la construcción de viviendas en el norte.
La enfermera le tomó el pulso antes de la operación.
У спортсмена после бега был очень частый пульс.
The headline shouted LOST IN THE MULTIVERSE above a blurry photo.
Tras el colapso del puente, el tráfico se desvió por el pueblo.
The banner over the stage said A DIVERSE NATION in red letters.
quiet: The documentary was called A SHORT HISTORY OF THE UNIVERSITY and ran for two hours.
On holiday she likes to imitate the accents in a long novel.
La nueva ley permite la construcción de viviendas en el norte.
La enfermera le tomó la mano antes de la operación.
У спортсмена после бега был очень усталый вид.
The headline shouted LOST IN THE MOUNTAINS above a blurry photo.
Er ist immer pünktlich, und das Essen ist immer warm.
On an impulse he bought a universal remote and a diving mask.

notes: Card: no single token, but every top example is a mid-word piece whose continuation starts with s (the + direction suppresses 'se', 'ser', 'SE', 'so', so the - pole promotes them). Probes: UNIVERSE 0.92, MULTIVERSE 1.11, impulsa/pulso 0.80, пульс 0.86, immerse 0.56; UNIVERSITY 0.03, English 'impulse' 0.01, German 'immer' 0.00. Depends on the tokenizer splitting the word before the s.
